title: ci: an opt-in label lane runs the 18.x upgrade harness on a line PR's merge preview (step 0 wiring)
body:
Part of #24522
Clause-②: no — a CI workflow, an expected-skip roster row and a label declaration; nothing a package publishes changes

The second, governed half of step 0 of the 18.x line: the **wiring** that lets the line's PRs run the upgrade harness **before** they merge. The harness itself (test, fixture, generator) is the sibling draft PR on `claude/issue-24522-18x-upgrade-harness`, and this PR's job runs that file. Land it **with or after** that PR. Before then, a labelled run fails loudly on a missing file: the dogfood config's filter preflight refuses a named path that selects no test.

## 维护者速读（草稿）

- **改了什么：** 新增一个按标签触发的 CI 任务。PR 打上 `needs:upgrade-harness` 标签后，CI 会在合并预览上用 18.0 的样本数据库启动当前代码，检查数据是否完好、v17 数据库是否仍被拒绝。没有标签的 PR 不运行，不花钱。另外两处是配套登记：预期跳过名单加一行，标签声明脚本加一行。
- **为什么改：** 您定的 18.x 原则是每次合并后 `main` 都能随时发版，其中 R2 要求「18.0 装出来的数据库升级到这个提交后能启动、数据不丢」，并要求在合并前检查。dogfood 测试现在只在 `main` 上跑，PR 阶段跑不到，所以要加这个入口。
- **风险与代价（含回滚）：** 每个打了标签的 PR 约多一个 CI 任务：构建 dogfood 依赖（有缓存时较快，冷构建约 10 分钟）加约 1 分钟的测试。它不是必需检查，不进合并队列，也不影响其他 PR。回滚方法是删掉这个 workflow 文件。
- **席位意见：**
- **你要做的：** 审阅并批准合并（`.github/workflows/**` 属 Tier H）。标签对象由席位用 `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` 创建；之后席位给 18.x 线上的每个 PR 打这个标签。

## What it adds

- `.github/workflows/upgrade-harness-optin.yml` — job `18.x upgrade harness (opt-in)`.
  - It runs on `pull_request` (opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled), and only while the PR carries `needs:upgrade-harness`. A `labeled` event must name that label.
  - It checks out the merge preview, restores the dogfood job's turbo cache read-only, builds `--filter=@objectstack/dogfood`, and runs `vitest run test/upgrade-18x-harness.dogfood.test.ts`.
  - Concurrency is set at job level, so a skipped run never cancels a real one. There is no `merge_group` trigger, and the job is not a required context. This mirrors `pack-smoke-optin.yml`, whose header argues each choice.
- `scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs` — the job's name enters `EXPECTED_SKIPS` as a label-gated skip, so the enqueue bar does not read its skip on every other PR as a filter miss.
- `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` — declares the label object (colour and description). ⛔ Never auto-applied.

## Why this shape (measured)

| wiring | cost per line PR | why not / why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| run it on every PR | build closure plus ~54 s on every PR in the repo | taxes every PR for one release line |
| `workflow_dispatch` `ci.yml` on the PR branch | the full battery: 3 dogfood shards, Temporal Conformance and the console pin | no diff needed, but a manual act with no trigger a PR carries, and ~20× the runner time for one file |
| **label lane (this PR)** | the dogfood build closure (turbo cache restored) plus one file: 53.89 s locally, of which 42.8 s is import | runs only where the seat asks; the ruled shape for a pre-merge check most PRs do not need |

## Gates (on this branch, head as pushed)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 52 commands. All 52 exit 0.
  - `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` ran on its own: `✓ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 1913 cases pass` in 465.4 s.
  - `pnpm check:pm-expected-skips` and `pnpm check:pm-label-desc-cap` exit 0.
  - `node scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs --self-test` gave `✓ … 154 cases pass`; it reads the roster's truth against this checkout's workflows.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/issue-24522-harness-lane` reads `GOVERNED`, landing tier **H**, 136 changed lines.
